findings.fix: Remove the assumption from `refl`, `refl_apply`, `trans`, `trans_apply`, the algebra laws at lines 267–336, and `toAmbientIsotopy_refl`/`toAmbientIsotopy_trans` (including its private helper); retain it only for declarations that construct or mention `slice`/`final`.
findings.issue: `refl`, `trans`, and all nonslice results derived from them unnecessarily require `[IsManifold J ∞ M]`; this restricts the natural group-like API despite `Diffeotopy`, `Diffeomorph.refl`, and `Diffeomorph.trans` needing only `ChartedSpace`.

summary: The algebraic and forgetful API carries an unnecessary manifold assumption even though the underlying diffeomorphism operations are defined for any charted space.
